intent: A non-modal inspector dialog for editing one media effect: its type, and either the shadow position/blur/spread/color/opacity or a blur-only radius, anchored beside the inspector rail.
guidance: Anchor it to the effect's row with `trigger`; it docks to the inspector surface's left edge (8px gutter) so it clears the rail wherever the trigger sits. It is non-modal and does not trap focus, so the canvas stays live behind it and Escape closes. The rendered field set is the capability boundary: shadow types (Drop/Inner) expose position, blur, spread, color, and opacity; blur types (Layer/Background) expose only Blur; and only Drop shadow adds the show-behind-transparent toggle, so passing shadow bindings to a blur effect makes no phantom controls. Opening the nested color picker sets `blockOutsideDismiss`, so a click inside it won't dismiss the dialog. Pass `keyframes` only for controls the host actually animates.

anatomy.description: 40px title bar with a bottom border; holds the type dropdown, the visibility toggle, and Close.
Leading Dropdown opening a checkmark menu of the four effect types (Drop shadow, Inner shadow, Layer blur, Background blur).
Eye / eye-off button that shows or hides the effect (aria-label reflects the current state).
X button that dismisses the dialog.
Padded field column (12px inset, 4px row gap) below the header.
Labeled control rows: Position (X/Y pair), Blur, Spread, Color, and Opacity for shadows, or a single Blur row for blur types; each shows a keyframe diamond when the host supplies a binding.

use_when: Editing one media effect's parameters from a selected effect row in the inspector.
A shadow (drop/inner) or blur (layer/background) needs inline numeric and color controls beside the rail.
dont_use_when: A blocking confirmation is needed — use a modal Dialog.
Managing the ordered effect list or Add-effect flow — that lives in the inspector's Effects section.

slots.trigger: The control the dialog anchors to and launches from (e.g. the effect-type Dropdown in the panel row).
slots.keyframes: Host-owned motion bindings; each supplied control (position/blur/spread/color/opacity) exposes a keyframe diamond, omitted ones expose none.

states: shadow type (Drop/Inner): position, blur, spread, color, opacity rows
blur type (Layer/Background): a single Blur row
Drop shadow: adds the show-behind-transparent checkbox
color picker open: nested ColorDialog; blocks outside dismiss

tokens.note: Field labels use hardcoded type (text-[11px] / leading-[16px] / font-[450]), not a type token. Effect color falls back to the literal value #000000 (a data default, not a styling color); because a #hex literal is present in the source, tokensOnly is false. Surface, border, and icon colors all bind to c-* tokens.

a11y.role: dialog (non-modal — aria-label "Effect details", aria-modal false; the inspector dialog does not trap focus). Escape closes it.
a11y.visibilityToggle: <button> whose aria-label is "Hide effect" / "Show effect", reflecting current visibility.
a11y.fields: Each numeric/color input carries an ariaLabel (Position X/Y, Blur, Spread, Effect color, Opacity); the type menu marks the active option with a checkmark.

code.example: <EffectDetailsDialog open={open} value={{ type: 'Drop shadow', visible: true, x: 0, y: 4, blur: 8, spread: 0, color: '#000000', opacity: 25 }} trigger={<Dropdown value="Drop shadow" hug />} onChange={patch => update(patch)} onClose={close} />
